# North Shore Garage Doors

> Family-owned garage door repair, spring replacement, opener installation and new-door
> installation serving West Vancouver and the North Shore of Metro Vancouver, BC.
> Same-day and emergency service, upfront published pricing, licensed (business licence),
> insured & WorkSafeBC-covered. Phone: (778) 800-0769.

## Key facts
- Business: North Shore Garage Doors
- Service area: West Vancouver, North Vancouver, British Properties, Ambleside, Dundarave, Caulfeild, Horseshoe Bay, Lions Bay, Bowen Island (North Shore, Metro Vancouver, BC, Canada)
- Phone: (778) 800-0769 · Email: info@northshoregaragedoors.ca
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00–19:00, Sat–Sun 8:00–18:00 (emergency service available)
- Authorized LiftMaster® opener dealer
- Positioning: premium-coastal, family-owned, honest upfront pricing, no call centres

## Services
- [Garage Door Repair](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/garage-door-repair/): off-track doors, broken cables, noisy operation, same-day repair.
- [Spring Replacement](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/spring-repair/): torsion/extension springs in three cycle-rated tiers (Standard / High-Cycle / Premium Lifetime).
- [Openers & Smart Control](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/opener-installation/): LiftMaster belt-drive, wall-mount and Wi-Fi/myQ openers supplied, installed and repaired.
- [New Garage Doors](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/new-garage-doors/): modern, carriage, full-view glass and insulated steel doors for the West Coast climate.
- [Cables, Rollers & Tracks](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/cable-roller-repair/): frayed cables, worn rollers, bent tracks.
- [Maintenance & Tune-Ups](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/maintenance-tune-up/): 25-point safety inspection, balance, lubrication, alignment.
- [Strata & Townhomes](https://www.northshoregaragedoors.ca/strata-townhomes/): multi-unit maintenance, priority response, consolidated invoicing for property managers.
